ja: • 新幹線500系「こだま」がV編成仕様でリニューアル登場。
• ２号車（526形7000番台）兼４号車（528形7000番台）用の側面・窓ガラスと４号車・５号車用の屋根板が付属。６号車の代わりに４号車を組み立てることができる。
• 別売りのBセット７号車の屋根を使うことで２号車を組み立てることも可能。
• ６号車は既発売の「のぞみ」編成の10号車（516形）としても利用可能。・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
en: • Shinkansen 500 series "Kodama" has been renewed with V formation specification.
• A 2-car set of car No. 1 (521 type 7000 series) and car No. 6 (526 type 7200 series).
• Side and window glass for car No. 2 (526 type 7000 series) and car No. 4 (528 type 7000 series) and roof plates for cars No. 4 and 5 are included. You can assemble car No. 4 instead of car No. 6.
• It is also possible to assemble car No. 2 by using the roof of car No. 7 of B set (sold separately).
• Car No. 6 can also be used as Car No. 10 (Type 516) of the previously released "Nozomi" formation.・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
